sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the SHACL-SPARQL polarity and obligation logic. A sh:sparql SELECT reports a violation when it returns $this; select only applicable ships (operatingArea = "Antarctic_area" and marpolAnnexVRegulation6Point1DischargeOccurs = true) that fail an obligation, rather than compliant ships. For every applicable ship require distanceToNearestFastIce to be present as a QuantityValue in MI_N with numericValue >= 12, require distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth to be recorded in MI_N unconditionally regardless of concentration branch, and require foodWasteDischargeOntoIce = false.
